issue: Three category cards occupy a two-by-two template and leave one empty quadrant.
recommendation: Use three equal-width full-height cards on the final category page.
acceptance_test: All three cards remain at least 8-point body text and page whitespace is visually balanced.

issue: Operational source-packaging instructions consume reader-facing appendix space.
recommendation: Replace with a short source-availability and lineage note; keep split-archive procedure in repository documentation.
space_effect: Frees approximately one card for source and method boundaries.
acceptance_test: No compression-volume or staging-copy procedure appears in the public PDF.

issue: The repeated subtitle uses internal canonical terminology.
recommendation: Use one concise subtitle: "Category counts and Alaska status beneath the integrated profiles."
space_effect: Reduces repeated line length and visual noise.
acceptance_test: All nine pages use the same plain-language subtitle.

issue: The 16-step workflow page is the densest methodology page.
recommendation: Keep each step to one sentence and use the existing three-column card grid; do not add prose.
space_effect: Preserves readable type without adding a page.
acceptance_test: Every card remains legible at 100-percent zoom.

issue: Combined methodology topics could repeat workflow concepts.
recommendation: Limit page 43 to roles and tools; limit page 44 to execution design and its tradeoffs.
space_effect: Removes conceptual repetition without changing pagination.
acceptance_test: No sentence-level duplication with pages 41-42 above the documented tolerance.

issue: One incident registry is split across two pages.
recommendation: Keep the split by incident family and avoid repeating the general failure preamble.
acceptance_test: Every verified incident appears once and each page has at least four incident cards.

issue: Relocated analytical visuals could be mistaken for a new cross-mechanism section.
recommendation: Keep them under Compensation mechanisms and use direct cross-references to the related profiles.
space_effect: Preserves three useful figures without an extra section opener.
acceptance_test: Bookmarks and running headers contain no Cross-Mechanism section.

issue: Local comparisons are the fourth relocated visual but test claim direction.
recommendation: Keep the page under Final claim boundaries.
acceptance_test: The local-comparison page immediately precedes claim-class pages.

recommendation: Retain two cards per page; do not compress to smaller type.
space_effect: Uses space for readable exact wording.
acceptance_test: All strict broader prohibited and uncertainty text remains complete and at least 7.5 points.

issue: Two limitation topics share each page.
recommendation: Retain paired cards and cap each subsection to the current line budget.
space_effect: Avoids six extra pages while keeping all 12 topics.
acceptance_test: Constraint success and boundary are present for every limitation.

recommendation: Keep only the core 16 terms on-page and preserve the complete glossary as a companion table.
acceptance_test: Every term used before its profile is defined on pages 3-5 or in its profile.

issue: Standalone divider pages would increase length without evidence.
recommendation: Use running section headers and bookmarks only.
acceptance_test: No page contains only a part title and subtitle.
